mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the federal funds rate above 0.10% signals imminent monetary tightening that raises equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered periods, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in payroll employment and decline in unemployment rate indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, or Rank IC for interaction signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, rising housing starts and residential sales signal robust consumer demand and economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of late-cycle periods when both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or Rank IC for interaction signal falls below 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic activity, which precedes higher corporate profits and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1600 thousand units in a month signal strong residential construction activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of triggered periods, or Rank IC for the signal falls below 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 260), sustained CPI increases signal persistent inflation that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of high inflation periods, or Rank IC for the signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate below 5.5% signals a tight labor market that may generate wage pressures and inflation, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the Fed may tighten policy.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered periods, or Rank IC for the signal falls below 0.05 over any 3-year window.
